open_defects_found: S3.1 needs a fourth screen outcome: K2-unobservable (access closed). Without it, a denial of credit scores as insensitivity to its price.
S3.1 'committed quantity' must be defined as NEW commitments dated after the cost rise, not outstanding stock or backlog.
S2.5 needs a layer KIND: chain (complements -> least flexible binds) vs alternatives (substitutes -> share-weighted sum, most flexible sets the margin).
S4.1 does not state whether Gamma is absolute or excess over cash; the spec's -4.8%/yr metal figure is correct only on the excess-over-cash reading.
S12.8 (no downside levels for P) remains the binding constraint: 11 of 12 markets unclassified in a synchronous de-rating.
S3.3's dependence on an implied-vol series makes P2 unreachable for DXY; the replacement is a trend x volatility grid with realised vol as the common basis.
